level.title: Mandarin A2+ — Connected explanations for visits, work and travel
goals: Describe a symptom and clarify a professional instruction.
Report deadlines, learning summaries and progress.
Attribute forecasts, reschedule plans and explain a route.

lessons.title: Describe a symptom
lessons.learn: Describe a symptom and say when it began.

grammar.title: duration with 从
grammar.explain: Use 从 and 开始 to name when a symptom began.

examples.t: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
examples.r: wǒ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shàng kāi shǐ ké sòu。
examples.en: I started coughing last night.

examples.t: 今天早上我有点发烧。
examples.r: jīn tiān zǎo shàng wǒ yǒu diǎn fā shāo。
examples.en: I have a slight fever this morning.

examples.t: 请问需要预约吗？
examples.r: qǐng wèn xū yào yù yuē ma？
examples.en: May I ask whether I need an appointment?

mistakes.right: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
mistakes.why: Use 从...开始 to introduce the starting point.

dialogue.t: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。

dialogue.en: I started coughing last night.

dialogue.t: 今天早上我有点发烧。
dialogue.r: jīn tiān zǎo shàng wǒ yǒu diǎn fā shāo。
dialogue.en: I have a slight fever this morning.

dialogue.t: 请问需要预约吗？
dialogue.r: qǐng wèn xū yào yù yuē ma？
dialogue.en: May I ask whether I need an appointment?

lessons.title: Confirm a follow-up
lessons.learn: Ask when to return and repeat an instruction for confirmation.

grammar.title: reported instruction
grammar.explain: Attribute the instruction to the clinician, then ask a confirmation question.

examples.t: 医生说两天后再来。
examples.r: yī shēng shuō liǎng tiān hòu zài lái。
examples.en: The doctor said to come back in two days.

examples.t: 我需要继续吃这种药吗？
examples.r: wǒ xū yào jì xù chī zhè zhǒng yào ma？
examples.en: Do I need to continue taking this medicine?

examples.t: 我把复诊时间记下来了。
examples.r: wǒ bǎ fù zhěn shí jiān jì xià lái le。
examples.en: I wrote down the follow-up time.

mistakes.wrong: 医生说我两天后回来吗。
mistakes.why: Report the instruction directly; use 吗 only for your follow-up question.

lessons.title: Ask for clarification
lessons.learn: Ask a professional to explain one unclear instruction.

grammar.title: clarification with 怎么
grammar.explain: Use 什么/怎么 to identify the part that needs clarification.

examples.t: 这句话是什么意思？
examples.r: zhè jù huà shì shén me yì si？
examples.en: What does this sentence mean?

examples.t: 请您再解释一下用药时间。
examples.r: qǐng nín zài jiě shì yí xià yòng yào shí jiān。
examples.en: Please explain the medication timing once more.

examples.t: 我确认以后再离开。
examples.r: wǒ què rèn yǐ hòu zài lí kāi。
examples.en: I will leave after I confirm it.

mistakes.why: Use the fixed question order 这句话是什么意思.

lessons.title: Ask about a deadline
lessons.learn: Ask for a deadline and state which part is ready.

grammar.title: polite clarification
grammar.pattern: 请问 + deadline + 是 ... 吗？
grammar.explain: Ask for a specific detail politely and state the part of the task already completed.

examples.t: 请问报告的截止日期是哪一天？
examples.r: qǐng wèn bào gào de jié zhǐ rì qī shì nǎ yì tiān？
examples.en: May I ask which day the report is due?

examples.t: 第一部分已经完成了。
examples.r: dì yí bù fèn yǐ jīng wán chéng le。
examples.en: The first section is already complete.

examples.t: 我会把文件作为附件发给您。
examples.r: wǒ huì bǎ wén jiàn zuò wéi fù jiàn fā gěi nín。
examples.en: I will send you the file as an attachment.

mistakes.right: 我会把文件作为附件发给您。
mistakes.why: Use 作为附件 to state the file's role in the email.

lessons.title: Explain a route
lessons.learn: Give two direction steps and check the listener understood.

grammar.title: sequence with 然后
grammar.explain: Use 先 and 然后 to sequence directions; a final check can confirm understanding.

examples.t: 先在路口向左转。
examples.r: xiān zài lù kǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn。
examples.en: First turn left at the intersection.

examples.t: 然后一直走到公交站。
examples.r: rán hòu yì zhí zǒu dào gōng jiāo zhàn。
examples.en: Then continue straight to the bus stop.

examples.t: 这样说清楚了吗？
examples.r: zhè yàng shuō qīng chǔ le ma？
examples.en: Is that clear?

mistakes.right: 先在路口向左转，然后继续直走。
mistakes.why: Place the location before the turn and sequence the second step with 然后.

culture.text: 您 is a respectful form of 你, but address choices depend on relationship, setting and local habit. A friendly conversation may use 你, while a service interaction may choose 您. Learners should listen to how people address one another instead of treating one form as universally required. At A2+, learners link an immediate need to a reason and a next step. In a health conversation, they should repeat only the instruction they heard and ask a qualified professional to clarify uncertainty.

reading.text: 小周昨天去过新图书馆。她说那里很安静，书也很多。朋友问她怎么去，她解释了公交路线，还提醒朋友周末要先查开放时间。 病人把复诊时间记在手机里。离开以前，她又确认了一次药的用法。
reading.gloss: Xiao Zhou has been to the new library. She said it was quiet and had many books. A friend asked how to get there; she explained the bus route and reminded the friend to check opening hours first on the weekend. The patient saved the follow-up time on her phone. Before leaving, she confirmed the medicine instructions once more.

listening.script:
朋友：你去过新图书馆吗？
小周：去过，那里很安静。
朋友：周末我也想去。
小周：出发前先查一下开放时间。
病人：我需要下周再来吗？
护士：请先确认预约日期。
病人：好，我把日期记下来了。
listening.gloss: Friend: Have you been to the new library? Xiao Zhou: Yes, it is quiet there. Friend: I want to go this weekend too. Xiao Zhou: Check the opening hours before you leave. Patient: Do I need to come again next week? Nurse: Please confirm the appointment date first. Patient: All right; I have written it down.

mistakes.why: 了 and 过 express different aspect meanings; avoid stacking them here.
会 marks a learned ability; do not add 可以 without a permission meaning.
Ask price with 多少钱; do not add a second price marker.
